title: Surreal Dream Sphere
description: A surreal painting shows two women in vintage hats and coats sitting in red theater seats at the bottom left, observing a large circular frame filled with yellow flowers, bones, and seashells. Inside the frame floats a transparent bubble containing a red-coated figure standing on a sand dune under an aurora-filled night sky with a crescent moon, while a golden staircase rises from a lily pond below.
